info.title: Khalifa API
info.description:
REST API for the Khalifa security graph: issues and attack paths, resources,
secrets, compliance, CIEM, and trends.

**Authentication.** Every endpoint except `/health`, `/livez`, `/readyz`,
`/metrics`, and `/openapi.json` requires a Bearer JWT — a Cognito token, or a
Cloudflare Access JWT when the Access provider fronts the API. RBAC groups:
`khalifa-admin`, `khalifa-analyst`, `khalifa-viewer`; each operation states
its role floor. `/compliance/reconciliation/publishable` accepts only the
Access service token configured for the trust-center sync.

**Rate limits.** A shared limiter applies to all routes; expensive
graph-heavy reads pass through an additional stricter limiter.

**Errors** are JSON: `{ "code": string, "message": string }`.

Docs: README.md (§API), ARCHITECTURE.md, OPERATIONAL.md.

get.description: Requires **Viewer**. Bounded per-type reads; counts may be null when the grouped count query fails.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Limit the response to one type (default: all).

200.description: Per-type sections with counts, items, and truncation flags.

get.summary: AI bill of materials (service-level inventory export)
get.description: Requires **Viewer**. A flat component export of the collected AI estate with a schema version, per-type totals, and truncation flags named explicitly. Service-level inventory collected read-only from AWS APIs — not a code-level SBOM (no libraries, container digests, or prompt contents) and not a CycloneDX or SPDX document.

200.description: `schemaVersion`, `documentType`, `generatedAt`, `scope`, `totals` (per type, null when the count traversal failed), `truncatedTypes`, and `components` (one per inventory item, carrying `componentType`).

get.summary: Shadow-AI usage: active anomalies and coverage statement
get.description: Requires **Viewer**. Active `SHADOW_AI_USAGE` anomalies — Bedrock/SageMaker management-plane usage by principals outside `AI_PRINCIPAL_ALLOWLIST`, resolved from the graph — with the API calls seen in `detail`. The `coverage` block states the plane explicitly: data-plane (model-invocation) events are visible only when CloudTrail data events are enabled, and `lastAnomalyObservedAt` is the analyzer's last recorded marker (`null` means unknown freshness, not a clean estate — the analyzer writes vertices only when it finds something).

200.description: `anomalies` (principal, source IP, account, event count, first/last seen, detail, observedAt) and `coverage` (`plane`, `windowDays`, `detail`, `lastAnomalyObservedAt`, `freshness`).

get.summary: One AI agent with role, knowledge bases, guardrail, tools, model, and issues

get.description: Requires **Viewer**. Hand-maintained governance entries linking use cases to collected AI assets.

200.description: Use cases and a truncation flag.

post.description: Requires **Analyst**. `id` (slug) is optional; it is derived from the name when absent. A colliding id answers 409.

assessment.description: Lite AI impact assessment: status, riskTier, owner, humanOversight, impacts, notes, reviewedAt.

get.summary: Registry against the collected AI estate (expensive query)
get.description: Requires **Viewer**. Unregistered collected assets and registered assets missing from the graph; both lists are bounded and truncation is flagged.

put.description: Requires **Analyst**. Replaces the editable fields; identity and timestamps stay server-owned.

get.description: Requires **Admin**. Never returns token material: the secret exists only in the create response.

200.description: Token metadata (id, name, role, expiry, last use, revocation).

post.description: Requires **Admin**. Returns the plaintext token once; only its hash is stored. Roles are viewer or analyst — administrative roles cannot be minted. Expiry is mandatory (1-90 days).

delete.description: Requires **Admin**. Revocation takes effect on the next request.
